name: kb_828_Normalized

schema.description: ResourceFieldSelector represents container resources (cpu, memory) and their output format

containerName.description: Container name: required for volumes, optional for env vars

divisor.description: Specifies the output format of the exposed resources, defaults to "1"

description:
The configuration specifies a ResourceFieldSelector for the container named **my-container**. It targets the **cpu** resource, ensuring that the selector extracts CPU usage metrics from that particular container.

The divisor is set to **1**, which means the output will be presented in the default format without any scaling applied. This setup fully defines the resource selection criteria for the container.
